offlineNote: Works offline. Data stays on this computer.

settings.title: Settings & master records
settings.description: The lists behind daily entry, reports and cash reconciliation.
settings.comingNext: This section is not built yet.

common.coreHint: Core records feed the cash reconciliation and cannot be switched off.
common.footnote: Switching an item to inactive hides it from daily entry. Past days and reports keep it.
common.reportsHint: Reports show the name in each viewer's language.
common.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.

categories.title: Expense categories
categories.description: Two levels: a parent category groups its sub-categories. Parents are shown in bold.
categories.hasChildrenHint: This category has sub-categories, so it stays at the top level.
categories.parentFootnote: Switching a parent off also switches its sub-categories off.

types.title: Expense types
types.description: How a cost behaves: fixed, variable or one-off. Every sub-category carries one.

errors.coreLocked: Core records cannot be switched off
errors.parentInvalid: Pick a top-level category as the parent
errors.parentInactive: Switch the parent category on first
errors.hasChildren: This category has sub-categories, so it cannot move under another one
errors.typeInactive: The channel type is switched off
errors.usedByClosedDays: This would change days that are already closed
errors.dayClosed: This day is closed. Reopen it to make changes.
errors.categoryInvalid: Choose an active category without sub-categories
errors.noteRequired: A note is required for this reason
errors.countRequired: Count the cash drawer before closing the day
errors.channelCycle: A channel cannot go under itself or under one of its own sub-channels
errors.channelTooDeep: Channels can go three levels deep: group, channel, variation
errors.channelInvalid: Sales are entered on a channel with no sub-channels
errors.dateFuture: The date cannot be in the future
errors.dayEmpty: There is nothing entered on this day
errors.dayClosedMove: This day is closed. Reopen it on the review step before moving it.
errors.targetNotEmpty: That date already has entries. Choose a date with nothing entered.
errors.tipOverTotal: Tips can’t be more than the total

db.lockedTitle: Daybook is already open in another tab
db.lockedBody: Close the other tab or window, then reload this page. Only one can use the data at a time.
db.failedTitle: The database could not be opened
db.memoryWarning: This browser cannot store data permanently, so changes will be lost when you close the page.

incomeChannels.title: Income channels
incomeChannels.description: Where takings come from, in groups such as Dine in and Delivery. Sales are entered on the channels at the bottom of each branch (Visa, not Card).
incomeChannels.countsHint: Yes only for cash that goes into the drawer, such as Cash.
incomeChannels.hasChildrenHint: This channel has sub-channels, so sales are entered on those, not on it.
incomeChannels.parentFootnote: Switching a group or channel off also switches off everything under it.

paidFrom.title: Paid-from accounts
paidFrom.description: Where the money for an expense came from. Only the cash drawer changes the expected cash.
paidFrom.derived: Affects the cash drawer: {{value}} (set by the account kind)

cashReasons.title: Cash movement reasons
cashReasons.description: Why cash was added to or taken out of the drawer, other than sales and expenses.

daily.title: Daily close
daily.description: Record the day's sales and expenses, count the drawer, then close the day.
daily.closedBanner: This day is closed. Reopen it on the review step to make changes.

sales.title: Sales
sales.description: Enter the day's takings on each channel at the bottom of a branch (Visa, not Card). Leave a channel empty if it had no sales.
sales.openingHint: Cash in the drawer when the day started. It starts from the last closed day's counted cash.
sales.noChannels: No active income channels. Add one in Settings.
sales.cardHint: Total from the machine, then Tab for tips

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Everything paid today, in the order entered. Type in the last row and press Enter to add it; click any cell above to change it.
expenses.drawerNote: Paid from the cash drawer: {{amount}} will be deducted from the expected cash for today.
expenses.otherNote: Not paid from the cash drawer, so the expected cash does not change.
expenses.uncategorisedHint: Not sure? Save it as uncategorised and sort it out later from the review step.
expenses.columnsNote: Hidden columns keep their saved values.
expenses.filledFrom: Filled in from the last time at {{name}}: {{what}}

cash.title: Cash drawer
cash.description: Cash added or taken out apart from sales and expenses, then the count.
cash.countedHint: Count the notes and coins in the drawer and enter the total.
cash.alert: Over the allowed difference of {{amount}}. Add a note on the review step before closing.
cash.noReasons: No active cash movement reasons. Add one in Settings.

review.title: Review & close
review.description: Check the day before closing it. A closed day is locked until it is reopened.
review.dayNoteHint: Explain anything unusual, such as a cash difference.
review.noteForVariance: Add a note explaining the cash difference before closing.
review.checkCount: The drawer has not been counted
review.checkVariance: The cash difference is over the allowed amount and needs a note
review.needsCategoryHint: Pick a category for each. This works even after the day is closed.
review.checkTips: {{channel}}: tips {{tips}} are more than the card total {{total}}

uncat.title: Expenses that need a category
uncat.description: Saved without a category, on any day. Choose one here, or open the day to see the whole entry.

discounts.title: Discounts given
discounts.hint: A memo. Enter sales as received, so a discount here never changes the cash count.
discounts.noReasons: No active discount reasons. Add one in Settings.

move.title: Move this day to another date
move.hint: Moves everything entered for {{date}} (sales, expenses, cash movements, discounts, the count and the note) to the new date. The new date must have nothing entered yet.

discountReasons.title: Discount reasons
discountReasons.description: Why a discount was given. Chosen when discounts are recorded on the sales step.

period.label: Period
period.pdfFailed: The PDF couldn't be saved. Try another folder.
period.openFailed: This computer couldn't open it. Open the file from the folder above.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: How the restaurant is doing: sales, expenses and profit or loss for the period you choose.
dashboard.profitSubtitle: Above the line is profit, below it is a loss
dashboard.empty: No closed days in this period yet.
dashboard.attention: Before you rely on these numbers
dashboard.openDays_one: {{count}} day in this period is still open, so it is not counted.
dashboard.openDays_other: {{count}} days in this period are still open, so they are not counted.
dashboard.varianceDays_one: {{count}} day has a cash difference over the allowance.
dashboard.varianceDays_other: {{count}} days have a cash difference over the allowance.
dashboard.note: Profit or loss is the sales received minus all expenses, whichever account paid them. Cash movements such as bank deposits are not income or cost. Sales are entered as received, so discounts are already taken off.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Sales, expenses and profit or loss by day, month, year or any date range.
reports.eachSale: Each sale, by day and channel
reports.eachSaleHint: One row for every day, one column for every channel that had sales.
reports.topMarketsHint: Spending per supplier or market, biggest first. The same name in different capitals counts as one.
reports.everyExpenseHint: In the order entered, with each day's total.
reports.lineLimit: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} expenses. Export to CSV to get them all.
reports.daysHint: Each day's figures and its cash count. Click a date to open that day.
reports.byMainCategoryHint: Click a main category to see its sub-categories, then a sub-category to see each expense behind it.

backup.folderHint: Where backups are saved. Pick a folder on a USB drive or a second disk, so a backup survives if this computer fails.
backup.noFolderSupport: This browser can't save into a folder, so backups are downloaded to your Downloads folder. Use Chrome or Edge to choose a backup folder.
backup.needsPermission: The browser asks again for access after it restarts.
backup.noFolder: No folder chosen yet. Until you choose one, backups are downloaded to your Downloads folder.
backup.backupsHint: A full copy of all data on this computer, checked after it is written. A backup is also made each time a day is closed. With a folder chosen, every closed day also gets an Excel copy.
backup.downloaded: Backup downloaded: {{file}}. Move it to a USB drive or another safe place.
backup.restoreHint: Put a backup back. Everything on this computer is replaced by the backup, after a copy of the current data is saved.
backup.replaceWarning: Restoring replaces all data on this computer with this backup. A backup of the current data is made first, so this can be undone.
backup.restoredBody: Restored {{file}}. Data is complete up to {{day}} (last closed day). The data from before the restore was saved as {{safety}}.

errors.notSqlite: This is not a Daybook backup file.
errors.notDaybook: This database is not from Daybook.
errors.corrupt: This backup file is damaged and can't be used. Try an older one.
errors.newer: This backup was made by a newer version of Daybook. Update the app first.
errors.verifyFailed: The backup didn't match the data when checked, so it wasn't saved. Try again.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

backup.dayExcel: Also save each closed day as Excel
backup.dayExcelHint: Saved in the folder's excel subfolder as daybook-YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx, with the summary, sales, discounts, expenses and cash movements. For reading and sharing; restoring uses the database backup.
backup.excelAdded_one: Excel copy added for {{count}} closed day.
backup.excelAdded_other: Excel copies added for {{count}} closed days.
backup.whereProblem: downloaded, because the backup folder didn't keep the file
backup.folderBroken: The backup folder didn't keep the file (it came out empty), so the backup was downloaded instead: {{file}}.
backup.folderBrokenHint: This folder doesn't store files correctly. Google Drive opened through the Files app (google-drive://) is known to leave empty files. Choose a folder on this computer or a USB drive. To keep a copy in Google Drive, use a folder that the Google Drive app syncs.

updates.title: Updates
updates.hint: New versions of Daybook come from the internet. Anyone can check; only the manager can install, with the admin PIN.
updates.desktopOnly: Updates are for the desktop app. This browser version is always the latest.
updates.off: Updates are switched off in this copy of Daybook (a test or development build).
updates.checkFailed: Couldn't check for updates. Check the internet connection and try again later.
updates.noPinInBuild: This copy of Daybook was built without an admin PIN, so it can't install updates. Install the next version from the setup file.
updates.readyHint: The update is downloaded. A backup is made first, then Daybook closes, installs the update and opens again. This takes about a minute.
updates.pinHint: Only the manager has this PIN.
updates.wrongPin_one: That PIN is not right. {{count}} try left before it locks.
updates.wrongPin_other: That PIN is not right. {{count}} tries left before it locks.
updates.locked: Too many wrong tries. Try again after {{time}}.
updates.failed: The update didn't go through. Daybook is still on the version it had. Check the backup folder and the internet connection, then try again.
updates.banner: Version {{version}} of Daybook is available. Ask the manager to install it.

retention.title: Keeping old backups
retention.usage_one: {{count}} backup · {{size}} MB · older ones are thinned out after each new backup
retention.usage_other: {{count}} backups · {{size}} MB · older ones are thinned out after each new backup
retention.ruleSafe: The newest 10 backups and copies made before a restore or update are always kept. Excel copies are never deleted.
retention.saveHint: Old backups outside the new rules are removed on save. Minimums: 7, 30, 90 days, 12 months (0 months = for ever).
retention.locked: Too many wrong tries. Try again in a few minutes.
retention.pinAgain: The approval ran out. Press Change and enter the PIN again.
retention.saved: Saved. Backups outside the new rules were removed.
